notes: SwarmPeg/IMD hook launch on Ethereum mainnet (chain 1), built with Solidity 0.8.26, Cancun, optimizer 200, via_ir, bytecode_hash none. Constructor: SwarmPegHook(IPoolManager $poolManager, SwarmPeg $token, address $factory), in that order; the hook has no owner, admin, pauser or upgrade path, so no $owner argument exists, and it takes no external pot address: the ownerless MaintenancePot is deployed inside the hook constructor and read from maintenancePot(). Permissions are exactly getHookPermissions(): beforeInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta; address flags 0x20cc (8396), mined by the factory via CREATE2 with the resolved arguments. beforeInitialize accepts only the PoolManager as caller and only $factory as sender, for the single token/IMD pool with LP fee 12500 and tick spacing 60; a second initialization reverts. pool.fee 12500 is the real LP fee the hook initializes with and is separate from the hook fee. initialPrice is the policy sentinel; the network deployer derives the opening price from the 2,500 IMD opening market cap after the token address fixes currency order. Hook fee: 2% of the gross IMD leg on every buy and sell, exact-input and exact-output, as the brief asks, taken in IMD and kept in IMD (not converted to ETH), 100% minted as IMD ERC-6909 claims owned by the pot in afterSwap, so swaps need no PoolManager inventory and work on a token-only seeded pool. When IMD is the specified currency (exact-input buy, exact-output sell) beforeSwap returns the fee as a specified delta before execution; a partial fill at the price limit then reverts rather than taxing unfilled volume. Otherwise afterSwap returns the fee on the unspecified IMD side and charges only executed volume. beforeSwapReturnDelta is used solely for this fee split and never fills or skips a trade. No fee share goes anywhere else. Anyone can call pot.redeem(amount) to burn claims into IMD held by the pot; the pot has no withdrawal, approval or spending function, so the reserve is immutable by design because the brief gives no distribution policy. Liquidity callbacks are not enabled, so the factory's zero-liquidity fee collect and all LP changes incur no hook fee or block. Token: SwarmPeg has no constructor arguments and mints the whole 18-decimal supply once to msg.sender (the factory); no owner, mint, pause or upgrade. Supply and allocation come from the launch policy, not this manifest. Glyphs: whole-token balance slots own unique IDs, fresh IDs on inflow, LIFO retirement on outflow, O(1) batches; glyphSVG/glyphURI render fully on-chain animated SVG (CSS keyframes) seeded from the issuance transfer, block data, previous holder, trade entropy and pulse; cosmetic only. Pulse rises 25 per two-sided trade, caps at 1000, decays 1 per minute; currentPulse, checkpointPulse, glyphTraits and events PoolBound, FeeAccrued, PulseUpdated, TradeRecorded expose it. Hook constants pin IMD to the paired currency address. 39 local tests pass with the verifier fuzz seed; see README.md and docs/SECURITY.md. No mainnet transaction was sent; the attesting deployer performs the factory launch.
